claims.source: SPX domains interact with or form part of a large variety of proteins that affect Pi homeostasis by transporting Pi across membranes, converting it into polyphosphates (polyP) or other metabolites, or regulating Pi-dependent transcription (Secco et al., 2012).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Secco et al., 2012.

claims.claim: Direct regulation of SPX-containing proteins by synthetic inositol pyrophosphates was shown for VTC, Pi transporters Pho91, and PHR transcription factors in plants.
claims.source: Direct regulation of an SPX-containing protein by synthetic inositol pyrophosphates was shown for the polyP polymerase VTC, the Pi transporters Pho91 and the PHR transcription factors in plants (Gerasimaite et al., 2017; Potapenko et al., 2018; Wild et al., 2016; Ried et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2015; Liu et al., 2016; Dong et al., 2019; Liu et al., 2023; Pipercevic et al., 2023; Guan et al., 2023).
claims.evidence: This is supported by multiple citations.

claims.claim: Point mutants in the SPX domain rendered VTC either independent of activation by inositol pyrophosphates or non-responsive to them.
claims.source: A firm link suggesting that the SPX domain as the receptor for inositol pyrophosphate regulation was provided by point mutants in the SPX domain that rendered VTC either independent of activation by inositol pyrophosphates or non-responsive to them (Wild et al., 2016).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Wild et al., 2016.

claims.claim: The SPX domain binding site discriminates poorly between different inositol pyrophosphates at the level of binding.
claims.source: However, this binding site discriminates poorly between different inositol pyrophosphates at the level of binding (Wild et al., 2016).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Wild et al., 2016.

claims.claim: Strong differences are observed in the agonist properties of different inositol pyrophosphates, suggesting that binding affinity is a poor predictor of specificity and activity.
claims.source: By contrast, strong differences are observed in the agonist properties, leading to the suggestion that binding affinity is a poor predictor of inositol pyrophosphate specificity and activity (Austin and Mayer, 2020; Gerasimaite et al., 2017; Pipercevic et al., 2023).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Austin and Mayer, 2020; Gerasimaite et al., 2017; and Pipercevic et al., 2023.

claims.claim: Inositol pyrophosphates in various organisms carry seven (IP7) or eight (IP8) phosphates occupying positions around the myo-inositol ring.
claims.source: Inositol pyrophosphates that can be found in a wide variety of organisms carry seven (IP7) or eight (IP8) phosphates occupying every position around myo-inositol ring.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about inositol pyrophosphate structure.

claims.claim: The IP7 isomers 1PP-InsP5 and 5PP-InsP5 carry diphosphate groups at the 1- or 5-position, respectively.
claims.source: The IP7 isomers 1PP-InsP5 and 5PP-InsP5 carry diphosphate groups at the 1- or 5-position, respectively, and the 1,5(PP)2-InsP4 carries two diphosphate groups at the 1- and 5-position.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about inositol pyrophosphate nomenclature.

claims.claim: Genetic ablation of enzymes making inositol pyrophosphates (IP6Ks, PPIP5Ks, ITPKs) alters the phosphate starvation response.
claims.source: All three inositol pyrophosphates are linked to phosphate homeostasis by the fact that genetic ablation of the enzymes making them, such as IP6Ks (inositol hexakisphosphate kinases), PPIP5Ks (diphosphoinositol pentakisphosphate kinases), and ITPKs (inositol tris/tetrakisphosphate kinases), alters the phosphate starvation response.
claims.evidence: This is a general statement supported by the literature discussed in the introduction.

claims.claim: In mammalian cells, 1,5-IP8 activates the Pi exporter XPR1.
claims.source: In mammalian cells, 1,5-IP8 activates the only SPX protein expressed in this system, the Pi exporter XPR1 (Li et al., 2020; Wilson et al., 2019).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Li et al., 2020 and Wilson et al., 2019.

claims.claim: 1,5-IP8 was proposed as a regulator of the phosphate starvation response in Arabidopsis because it promotes the interaction of SPX1 with PHR1 in vitro.
claims.source: 1,5-IP8 was also proposed as a regulator of the phosphate starvation response in Arabidopsis because 1,5-IP8, but not 5-IP7, promotes the interaction of SPX1 with the Pi-responsive transcription factor PHR1 in vitro (Dong et al., 2019).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Dong et al., 2019.

claims.claim: Quantitative measurements showed only a minor, twofold difference in Kd values for 5-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 binding to rice SPX4 and PHR2.
claims.source: On the other hand, quantitative measurements of the interaction of inositol pyrophosphates with rice SPX4 and its cognate Pi-responsive transcription factor PHR2 revealed only a minor, twofold difference in the Kd values for 5-IP7 and 1,5-IP8.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the literature that contrasts with other findings.

claims.claim: 1-IP7, 5-IP7, and 1,5-IP8 all decrease upon Pi starvation in plants.
claims.source: 1-IP7, 5-IP7, and 1,5-IP8 all decrease upon Pi starvation and mutants lacking either of the enzymes necessary for their synthesis in plants, the ITPKs and the PPIP5Ks, induce the phosphate starvation response (Dong et al., 2019; Riemer et al., 2021; Laha et al., 2015; Zhu et al., 2019).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple studies on plants.

claims.claim: Pi concentration in Arabidopsis shoots correlates poorly with their content of IP7 and IP8.
claims.source: Analysis of respective Arabidopsis mutants revealed that Pi concentration in shoots correlates poorly with their content of IP7 and IP8 (Riemer et al., 2021).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Riemer et al., 2021.

claims.claim: Arabidopsis itpk1 mutants have similar 1,5-IP8 content as wildtype but almost twofold increased Pi content and fourfold reduced 5-IP7 content.
claims.source: While itpk1 mutants, lacking one of the enzymes that generates 5-IP7, have similar 1,5-IP8 content as wildtype, their Pi content is almost twofold increased and their 5-IP7 content is reduced by a factor of four.
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Riemer et al., 2021.

claims.claim: Arabidopsis mutants lacking PPIP5K VIH2 show a fivefold reduction of 1,5-IP8 but normal Pi content.
claims.source: Inversely, mutants lacking the PPIP5K VIH2 show a fivefold reduction of 1,5-IP8 but normal Pi content (Riemer et al., 2021).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Riemer et al., 2021.

claims.claim: 1,5-IP8 is the most responsive inositol pyrophosphate to Pi starvation and Pi re-feeding in plants.
claims.source: Although 1,5-IP8 is the inositol pyrophosphate that is the most responsive to Pi starvation and Pi re-feeding (Riemer et al., 2021) this has rendered it difficult to clearly resolve whether IP7, IP8, or both signal cellular Pi status to the Pi starvation program in vivo.
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Riemer et al., 2021.

claims.claim: Pioneering studies on S. cerevisiae concluded that the PHO pathway is triggered by an increase in 1-IP7.
claims.source: Pioneering studies on the regulation of the Pi starvation program of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the PHO pathway, concluded that this transcriptional response is triggered by an increase in 1-IP7 (Lee et al., 2007; Lee et al., 2008), whereas subsequent studies in the pathogenic yeast Cryptococcus neoformans proposed 5-IP7 as the necessary signaling compound (Desmarini et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Lee et al., 2007 and Lee et al., 2008.

claims.claim: Studies in Cryptococcus neoformans proposed 5-IP7 as the necessary signaling compound for the PHO pathway.
claims.source: Pioneering studies on the regulation of the Pi starvation program of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the PHO pathway, concluded that this transcriptional response is triggered by an increase in 1-IP7 (Lee et al., 2007; Lee et al., 2008), whereas subsequent studies in the pathogenic yeast Cryptococcus neoformans proposed 5-IP7 as the necessary signaling compound (Desmarini et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Desmarini et al., 2020.

claims.claim: Studies using S. cerevisiae VTC suggested that this enzyme is stimulated by 5-IP7 in vivo.
claims.source: Studies using the S. cerevisiae polyphosphate polymerase VTC as a model suggested that this enzyme, which is necessary for polyP accumulation under Pi-replete conditions, is stimulated by 5-IP7 in vivo (Gerasimaite et al., 2017; Liu et al., 2023; Lonetti et al., 2011; Auesukaree et al., 2005), whereas studies in Schizosaccharomyces pombe proposed IP8 as the stimulator (Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2021).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple studies.

claims.claim: Studies in S. pombe proposed IP8 as the stimulator of VTC.
claims.source: Studies using the S. cerevisiae polyphosphate polymerase VTC as a model suggested that this enzyme, which is necessary for polyP accumulation under Pi-replete conditions, is stimulated by 5-IP7 in vivo (Gerasimaite et al., 2017; Liu et al., 2023; Lonetti et al., 2011; Auesukaree et al., 2005), whereas studies in Schizosaccharomyces pombe proposed IP8 as the stimulator (Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2021).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2021.

claims.claim: S. pombe has similar enzymes for IP8 synthesis and hydrolysis as S. cerevisiae.
claims.source: S. pombe has similar enzymes for IP8 synthesis and hydrolysis as S. cerevisiae (Zhai et al., 2015; Randall et al., 2020; Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018; Topolski et al., 2016; Pöhlmann et al., 2014).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple studies.

claims.claim: Genetic ablation of 1-IP7 and IP8 production in S. pombe leads to hyper-repression of the transcriptional phosphate starvation response.
claims.source: In contrast to S. cerevisiae, genetic ablation of 1-IP7 and IP8 production in S. pombe leads to hyper-repression of the transcriptional phosphate starvation response (Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018; Sanchez et al., 2019; Benjamin et al., 2022) and interferes with the induction of the transcriptional phosphate starvation response.
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018; Sanchez et al., 2019; and Benjamin et al., 2022.

claims.claim: S. pombe lacks homologs of Pho81 and uses Csk1 instead of Pho85-Pho80 for phosphate-dependent transcriptional regulation.
claims.source: For example, it lacks homologs of Pho81 and uses Csk1 instead of Pho85-Pho80 for phosphate-dependent transcriptional regulation (Estill et al., 2015; Henry et al., 2011; Carter-O'Connell et al., 2012; Schwer et al., 2021).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple studies.

claims.claim: PHO pathway promoters in S. pombe overlap with and are strongly regulated by lncRNA transcription units.
claims.source: Furthermore, PHO pathway promotors in S. pombe overlap with and are strongly regulated by lncRNA transcription units (Sanchez et al., 2018; Schwer et al., 2015; Schwer et al., 2014).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Sanchez et al., 2018; Schwer et al., 2015; and Schwer et al., 2014.

claims.claim: Capillary electrophoresis coupled to mass spectrometry (CE-MS) permits resolution of many regio-isomers of IP7 and IP8 without radiolabeling.
claims.source: The recent use of capillary electrophoresis coupled to mass spectrometry (CE-MS) has dramatically improved the situation, permitting resolution of many regio-isomers of IP7 and IP8 without radiolabeling, and at superior sensitivity and throughput.
claims.evidence: This is a statement about the analytical method used in the study.

claims.claim: The PHO pathway is a paradigm for a Pi-controlled transcriptional response and regulation of phosphate homeostasis.
claims.source: We analyzed their impact on the PHO pathway, which is a paradigm for a Pi-controlled transcriptional response and the regulation of phosphate homeostasis (Austin and Mayer, 2020; Eskes et al., 2018; Conrad et al., 2014).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Austin and Mayer, 2020; Eskes et al., 2018; and Conrad et al., 2014.

claims.claim: The PHO pathway is a model for promoter activation, transcription initiation, chromatin remodeling, and nucleosome positioning.
claims.source: Beyond this physiological function, however, the PHO pathway also gained widespread recognition as a model for promotor activation, transcription initiation, chromatin remodeling, and nucleosome positioning (Korber and Barbaric, 2014).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Korber and Barbaric, 2014.

claims.claim: The cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor Pho81 translates intracellular Pi availability into activation of the CDK complex Pho85-Pho80.
claims.source: In the PHO pathway, the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor (CKI) Pho81 translates intracellular Pi availability into an activation of the cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) complex Pho85-Pho80 (Lee et al., 2007; Schneider et al., 1994; Ogawa et al., 1995; Yoshida et al., 1989).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple studies.

claims.claim: At high Pi, Pho85-Pho80 phosphorylates and inactivates the transcription factor Pho4, which accumulates in the cytosol.
claims.source: At high Pi, Pho85-Pho80 phosphorylates and inactivates the key transcription factor of the PHO pathway, Pho4, which then accumulates in the cytosol (Kaffman et al., 1998b; Kaffman et al., 1998a; Komeili and O'Shea, 1999).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Kaffman et al., 1998b; Kaffman et al., 1998a; and Komeili and O'Shea, 1999.

claims.claim: During Pi starvation, Pho81 inhibits Pho85-Pho80 kinase, leading to dephosphorylation and activation of Pho4.
claims.source: During Pi starvation, Pho81 inhibits the Pho85-Pho80 kinase, leading to dephosphorylation and activation of Pho4 and the ensuing expression of Pi-responsive genes (PHO genes).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about the PHO pathway.

claims.claim: A critical function was ascribed to 1-IP7 in activating the CDK inhibitor PHO81 in previous studies.
claims.source: A critical function was ascribed to 1-IP7 in activating the CDK inhibitor PHO81, allowing it to inhibit Pho85-Pho80 (Lee et al., 2007).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Lee et al., 2007.

claims.claim: IP7 concentration was reported to increase upon Pi starvation in previous studies.
claims.source: IP7 concentration was reported to increase upon Pi starvation, and this increase was considered as necessary and sufficient to inactivate Pho85-Pho80 kinase through Pho81 and trigger the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This references previous models that the current study challenges.

claims.claim: The 1-IP7 binding site on Pho81 was mapped to a short stretch of 80 amino acids called the 'minimum domain'.
claims.source: The 1-IP7 binding site on Pho81 was mapped to a short stretch of 80 amino acids, the 'minimum domain' (Lee et al., 2007; Lee et al., 2008; Ogawa et al., 1995; Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Lee et al., 2007; Lee et al., 2008; Ogawa et al., 1995; and Huang et al., 2001.

claims.claim: The minimum domain is in the central region of Pho81 and distinct from the N-terminal SPX domain.
claims.source: This domain is in the central region and distinct from the N-terminal SPX domain of Pho81.
claims.evidence: This is a structural description based on previous work.

claims.claim: Overexpression of the minimum domain rescued Pi-dependent regulation of the PHO pathway to some degree.
claims.source: Since overexpression of the minimum domain rescued Pi-dependent regulation of the PHO pathway to some degree, the key regulatory function was ascribed to this minimum domain and the SPX domain was considered as of minor importance.
claims.evidence: This references previous experimental findings.

claims.claim: Earlier studies based on unbiased mutagenesis identified mutations in regions of PHO81 outside the minimum domain with significant impact on PHO pathway activation.
claims.source: By contrast, earlier studies based on unbiased mutagenesis, which subsequently received much less attention, had identified mutations in other regions of PHO81 with significant impact on PHO pathway activation (Ogawa et al., 1995; Spain et al., 1995; Toh-E and Oshima, 1974; Creasy et al., 1993; Creasy et al., 1996).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to multiple earlier studies.

claims.claim: Some studies found global IP7 levels to decrease rather than increase upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: The situation is complicated by further studies, which found global IP7 levels to decrease rather than increase upon Pi starvation (Wild et al., 2016; Li et al., 2020; Lonetti et al., 2011; Kim et al., 2023).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Wild et al., 2016; Li et al., 2020; Lonetti et al., 2011; and Kim et al., 2023.

claims.claim: Three inositol pyrophosphates were detectable in S. cerevisiae: 1-IP7, 5-IP7, and 1,5-IP8.
claims.source: Three inositol pyrophosphates were detectable: 1-IP7, 5-IP7, and 1,5-IP8.
claims.evidence: This is supported by the CE-MS data shown in Figure 2.

claims.claim: The recovery rate of inositol pyrophosphates during extraction was 89% for 1-IP7, 90% for 5-IP7, and 75% for 1,5-IP8.
claims.source: This demonstrated that 89% of 1-IP7, 90% of 5-IP7, and 75% of 1,5-IP8 were recovered in the extract (Figure 2—figure supplement 1).
claims.evidence: This is supported by experimental data shown in Figure 2—figure supplement 1.

claims.claim: The average cell volume of S. cerevisiae is 42 fL.
claims.source: This yielded an average cell volume of 42 fL.
claims.evidence: This is based on measurements shown in Figure 2—figure supplement 2.

claims.claim: The nucleus occupies around 8% of the yeast cell volume and all other organelles collectively account for approximately 18%.
claims.source: Detailed morphometric studies of yeast showed that the nucleus occupies around 8% of this volume and that all other organelles collectively account for approx. 18% (Uchida et al., 2011).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Uchida et al., 2011.

claims.claim: In cells growing logarithmically on SC medium, the cytosolic concentrations are 0.5 µM for 1-IP7, 0.7 µM for 5-IP7, and 0.3 µM for 1,5-IP8.
claims.source: Taking this into account we can estimate the concentrations in the cytosolic space (including the nucleus, which is permeable to small molecules) of cells growing logarithmically on SC medium as 0.5 µM for 1-IP7, 0.7 µM for 5-IP7, and 0.3 µM for 1,5-IP8 (Figure 2A).
claims.evidence: This is based on calculations from experimental data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: 5-IP7 was not detected in the kcs1Δ mutant.
claims.source: 5-IP7 was not detected in the kcs1Δ mutant and 1-IP7 was strongly reduced in the vip1Δ strain.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: 1-IP7 was strongly reduced in the vip1Δ strain.
claims.source: 5-IP7 was not detected in the kcs1Δ mutant and 1-IP7 was strongly reduced in the vip1Δ strain.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: 1,5-IP8 was undetectable in kcs1Δ and decreased by 75% in vip1Δ.
claims.source: 1,5-IP8 was undetectable in kcs1Δ and decreased by 75% in vip1Δ.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: kcs1Δ mutants showed a two- to threefold decrease in 1-IP7.
claims.source: kcs1Δ mutants showed a two- to threefold decrease in 1-IP7, suggesting that the accumulation of 1-IP7 depends on 5-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: Most 1-IP7 in wildtype cells stems from the conversion of 5-IP7 to 1,5-IP8, followed by dephosphorylation of 1,5-IP8 to 1-IP7.
claims.source: This might be explained by assuming that, in the wildtype, most 1-IP7 stems from the conversion of 5-IP7 to 1,5-IP8, followed by dephosphorylation of 1,5-IP8 to 1-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observed interdependency of inositol pyrophosphate levels in different mutants.

claims.claim: vip1Δ mutant showed up to 20-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7.
claims.source: An unexpected finding was the up to 20-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7 in the vip1Δ mutant.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: ddp1Δ cells showed normal levels of 5-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 but a 10-fold increase in 1-IP7.
claims.source: By contrast, ddp1Δ cells showed normal levels of 5-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 but a 10-fold increase in 1-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: siw14Δ cells showed a fivefold increase in 5-IP7, but similar levels of 1,5-IP8 and 1-IP7 as wildtype.
claims.source: siw14Δ cells showed a fivefold increase in 5-IP7, but similar levels of 1,5-IP8 and 1-IP7 as wildtype.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: 5-IP7 was the predominant inositol pyrophosphate species in wildtype cells growing on Pi-replete media.
claims.source: 5-IP7 was the predominant inositol pyrophosphate species in wildtype cells growing on Pi-replete media (Figure 2B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2B.

claims.claim: Within 30 min of Pi starvation, the concentration of inositol pyrophosphates rapidly decreased by 75% for 1,5-IP8, 47% for 1-IP7, and 40% for 5-IP7.
claims.source: Within 30 min of Pi starvation, the concentration of all three inositol pyrophosphate species rapidly decreased by 75% for 1,5-IP8, by 47% for 1-IP7, and by 40% for 5-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2B.

claims.claim: After 4 hr of Pi starvation, 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 became undetectable and only 3% of 5-IP7 remained.
claims.source: This decline continued, so that 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 became undetectable and only 3% of 5-IP7 remained after 4 hr, corresponding to a concentration below 50 nM.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2B.

claims.claim: The high excess of 5-IP7 in vip1Δ cells declined as soon as the cells were transferred to Pi starvation medium.
claims.source: The high excess of 5-IP7 in vip1Δ cells also declined as soon as the cells were transferred to Pi starvation medium (Figure 2C).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2C.

claims.claim: After 2 hr of starvation, 5-IP7 in vip1Δ cells was still twofold above the concentration measured in Pi-replete wildtype cells.
claims.source: After 2 hr of starvation, it was still twofold above the concentration measured in Pi-replete wildtype cells.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2C.

claims.claim: After 3.5-4 hr of Pi starvation, vip1Δ cells had reached the 5-IP7 concentration of Pi-replete wildtype cells.
claims.source: Even after 3.5–4 hr, Pi-starved vip1Δ cells had just reached the 5-IP7 concentration of Pi-replete wildtype cells.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2C.

claims.claim: A comparable decline of all inositol pyrophosphate species upon Pi starvation was observed in S. pombe and C. neoformans.
claims.source: A comparable decline of all inositol pyrophosphate species upon Pi starvation could be observed in other fungi, such as S. pombe and C. neoformans (Figure 3), suggesting that this response is conserved.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 3.

claims.claim: The decline of inositol pyrophosphates upon Pi starvation is conserved across fungi.
claims.source: A comparable decline of all inositol pyrophosphate species upon Pi starvation could be observed in other fungi, such as S. pombe and C. neoformans (Figure 3), suggesting that this response is conserved.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on observations in multiple fungal species.

claims.claim: In wildtype cells grown under Pi-replete conditions, Pho4yEGFP was cytosolic and the PHO5 and PHO84 promoters were inactive.
claims.source: In wildtype cells grown under Pi-replete conditions, Pho4yEGFP was cytosolic and the PHO5 and PHO84 promotors were inactive, indicating that the PHO pathway was repressed (Figure 4).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: Within 30 min of Pi starvation, Pho4yEGFP relocated into the nucleus and PHO84 and PHO5 were strongly induced in wildtype cells.
claims.source: Within 30 min of starvation in Pi-free medium, Pho4yEGFP relocated into the nucleus and PHO84 and PHO5 were strongly induced.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: kcs1Δ cells showed Pho4yEGFP constitutively in the nucleus already under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: By contrast, kcs1Δ cells showed Pho4yEGFP constitutively in the nucleus already under Pi-replete conditions, and PHO5 and PHO84 promoters were activated.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: kcs1Δ cells have strongly reduced 1,5-IP8 and 5-IP7, and 50% less 1-IP7 than wildtype.
claims.source: These cells have strongly reduced 1,5-IP8 and 5-IP7, and 50% less 1-IP7 than the wildtype.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: A decline of inositol pyrophosphates coincides with the induction of the Pi starvation program.
claims.source: Thus, a decline of inositol pyrophosphates not only coincides with the induction of the Pi starvation program, but the genetic ablation of these compounds is sufficient for a forced triggering of this response in Pi-replete conditions.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the correlation between inositol pyrophosphate levels and PHO pathway activation.

claims.claim: Genetic ablation of inositol pyrophosphates is sufficient for triggering the Pi starvation response in Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: Thus, a decline of inositol pyrophosphates not only coincides with the induction of the Pi starvation program, but the genetic ablation of these compounds is sufficient for a forced triggering of this response in Pi-replete conditions.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data showing that kcs1Δ cells activate the PHO pathway even in Pi-replete conditions (Figure 4).

claims.claim: Inositol pyrophosphates repress the PHO pathway, and their loss upon Pi starvation creates the signal that activates the starvation response.
claims.source: Therefore, we explored the hypothesis that inositol pyrophosphates repress the PHO pathway, and that their loss upon Pi starvation creates the signal that activates the starvation response.
claims.evidence: This is a hypothesis proposed based on the experimental observations.

claims.claim: vip1Δ cells maintained the PHO pathway repressed in Pi-replete medium.
claims.source: In this case, we must explain the behavior of the vip1Δ mutation, which strongly reduces 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 and maintains the PHO pathway repressed in Pi-replete medium.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: vip1Δ cells did not show nuclear relocation of Pho4 after 30 min of Pi withdrawal.
claims.source: Upon withdrawal of Pi, vip1Δ cells did not show nuclear relocation of Pho4 after 30 min and, even after 4 hr of starvation, PHO5 was not expressed.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figures 4 and 5.

claims.claim: After 4 hr of Pi starvation, PHO5 was not expressed in vip1Δ cells.
claims.source: Upon withdrawal of Pi, vip1Δ cells did not show nuclear relocation of Pho4 after 30 min and, even after 4 hr of starvation, PHO5 was not expressed.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4C.

claims.claim: The PHO84 promoter remained partially repressed in vip1Δ cells compared to wildtype upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: The PHO84 promoter remained partially repressed in comparison with the wildtype.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4D.

claims.claim: All three inositol pyrophosphate species strongly decline upon Pi starvation instead of showing an increase.
claims.source: First, all three inositol pyrophosphate species strongly decline upon Pi starvation instead of showing the increase postulated by Lee et al.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2B.

claims.claim: vip1Δ cells show a more than 15-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7.
claims.source: Second, vip1Δ cells show a more than 15-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: Genetic ablation of the 5-IP7 pool by deleting KCS1 is epistatic to the vip1Δ mutation.
claims.source: Genetic ablation of this pool by deleting KCS1 is epistatic to the vip1Δ mutation.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data showing that kcs1Δ vip1Δ double mutants activate the PHO pathway (Figure 4).

claims.claim: A kcs1Δ vip1Δ double mutant constitutively activates the PHO pathway already in presence of Pi.
claims.source: A kcs1Δ vip1Δ double mutant constitutively activates the PHO pathway already in presence of Pi, despite its strong reduction of 1-IP7 and the complete absence of 1,5-IP8.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: ddp1Δ cells, which show a 10-fold increase in 1-IP7 under Pi-replete conditions, did not induce the PHO84 and PHO5 promoters.
claims.source: Third, ddp1Δ cells, which show a 10-fold quite selective increase in 1-IP7 under Pi-replete conditions, did not induce the PHO84 and PHO5 promotors, nor did they show Pho4 accumulation in the nucleus in Pi-replete medium.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: ddp1Δ cells did not show Pho4 accumulation in the nucleus in Pi-replete medium.
claims.source: Third, ddp1Δ cells, which show a 10-fold quite selective increase in 1-IP7 under Pi-replete conditions, did not induce the PHO84 and PHO5 promotors, nor did they show Pho4 accumulation in the nucleus in Pi-replete medium.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: Even a strong increase in 1-IP7 is not sufficient to activate the PHO pathway.
claims.source: Thus, even a strong increase in 1-IP7 is not sufficient to activate the PHO pathway, while reductions of inositol pyrophosphates do this.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the ddp1Δ phenotype.

claims.claim: Reductions of inositol pyrophosphates activate the PHO pathway.
claims.source: Thus, even a strong increase in 1-IP7 is not sufficient to activate the PHO pathway, while reductions of inositol pyrophosphates do this.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data showing that kcs1Δ cells, which have reduced inositol pyrophosphates, constitutively activate the PHO pathway (Figure 4).

claims.claim: vip1Δ cells, which have virtually no 1-IP7, do not constitutively activate the PHO pathway.
claims.source: The data described above argues against a diminution of 1-IP7 as a critical factor for induction of the PHO pathway because vip1Δ cells, which have virtually no 1-IP7, do not constitutively activate the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: vip1Δ kcs1Δ double mutants show constitutive PHO pathway activity.
claims.source: By contrast, vip1Δ kcs1Δ double mutants, which not only have low levels of 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 but also strongly reduced 5-IP7, show constitutive PHO pathway activity (Figure 4).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 4.

claims.claim: In vip1Δ cells, Pho4yEGFP relocation followed a sigmoidal curve upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: In vip1Δ, Pho4yEGFP relocation followed a sigmoidal curve.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 5B.

claims.claim: The nuclear/cytosolic ratio of Pho4yEGFP in vip1Δ cells strongly increased after 1 hr of Pi starvation, reaching a plateau after 3 hr.
claims.source: The nuclear/cytosolic ratio strongly increased after 1 hr, reaching a plateau after 3 hr.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 5B.

claims.claim: Pho4yEGFP relocation in vip1Δ cells was stimulated when the 20-fold exaggerated 5-IP7 levels had declined below 5 µM.
claims.source: Thus, relocation was stimulated when the 20-fold exaggerated 5-IP7 levels of the vip1Δ cells had declined below 5 µM (Figure 2C), which is six to seven times above the maximal concentration observed in Pi-replete wildtype cells.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on correlating the time course of 5-IP7 decline (Figure 2C) with Pho4 relocation (Figure 5B).

claims.claim: The critical concentration of 5-IP7 that can repress the PHO pathway is at 5 µM.
claims.source: Since 5-IP7 is the only inositol pyrophosphate that exists in vip1Δ cells in significant amounts, this observation places the critical concentration of 5-IP7 that can repress the PHO pathway at 5 µM.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the vip1Δ phenotype and inositol pyrophosphate measurements.

claims.claim: In Pi-replete wildtype cells, 5-IP7 never reaches 5 µM.
claims.source: In Pi-replete wildtype cells, 5-IP7 never reaches 5 µM (Figure 2) and, therefore, 5-IP7 is unlikely to be a physiological repressor of the PHO pathway in wildtype cells.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2.

claims.claim: 5-IP7 is unlikely to be a physiological repressor of the PHO pathway in wildtype cells.
claims.source: In Pi-replete wildtype cells, 5-IP7 never reaches 5 µM (Figure 2) and, therefore, 5-IP7 is unlikely to be a physiological repressor of the PHO pathway in wildtype cells.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the concentration threshold determined in vip1Δ cells.

claims.claim: The 5-IP7-dependent PHO pathway repression in vip1Δ cells is a non-physiological reaction resulting from overaccumulation of 5-IP7.
claims.source: The 5-IP7-dependent PHO pathway repression in vip1Δ cells must then be considered as a non-physiological reaction resulting from the strong overaccumulation of 5-IP7 in these cells.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on comparing vip1Δ and wildtype 5-IP7 levels.

claims.claim: siw14Δ cells accumulate 5-IP7 fourfold less than vip1Δ, remaining below the 5 µM threshold.
claims.source: Although these cells accumulate 5-IP7, they accumulate it fourfold less than vip1Δ, remaining below the 5 µM threshold where we should expect non-physiological repression of the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is based on data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: siw14Δ cells contain the same concentration of 1,5-IP8 as wildtype.
claims.source: However, siw14Δ cells contain the same concentration of 1,5-IP8 as the wildtype (Figure 2A), degrade it upon Pi starvation as the wildtype (Figure 2—figure supplement 3), and relocalize Pho4yEGFP with similar kinetics as the wildtype (Figure 5B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2A.

claims.claim: siw14Δ cells degrade 1,5-IP8 upon Pi starvation as wildtype.
claims.source: However, siw14Δ cells contain the same concentration of 1,5-IP8 as the wildtype (Figure 2A), degrade it upon Pi starvation as the wildtype (Figure 2—figure supplement 3), and relocalize Pho4yEGFP with similar kinetics as the wildtype (Figure 5B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 2—figure supplement 3.

claims.claim: siw14Δ cells relocalize Pho4yEGFP with similar kinetics as wildtype.
claims.source: However, siw14Δ cells contain the same concentration of 1,5-IP8 as the wildtype (Figure 2A), degrade it upon Pi starvation as the wildtype (Figure 2—figure supplement 3), and relocalize Pho4yEGFP with similar kinetics as the wildtype (Figure 5B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 5B.

claims.claim: 1,5-IP8 is the only inositol pyrophosphate that correlates with PHO pathway activation in all mutants and conditions.
claims.source: Taken together with the evidence presented above, 1,5-IP8 thus ends up being the only inositol pyrophosphate that correlates with the activation of the PHO pathway in all mutants and conditions.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the comprehensive analysis of multiple mutants.

claims.claim: 1,5-IP8 is the controller of the PHO pathway.
claims.source: This points to 1,5-IP8 as the controller of the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the correlation analysis.

claims.claim: Previous studies proposed a small peptide from the central region of Pho81 (amino acids 645-724), called the minimum domain, as a receptor for 1-IP7.
claims.source: This prompted us to also re-evaluate the regulation of Pho81 because previous studies had proposed a small peptide from the central region of Pho81, called the minimum domain (amino acids 645–724), as a receptor for 1-IP7 that triggers the PHO pathway (Lee et al., 2007; Lee et al., 2008).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Lee et al., 2007 and Lee et al., 2008.

claims.claim: Earlier work suggested that the N- and C-terminal portions of Pho81 could provide competing inhibitory and stimulatory functions.
claims.source: This expression of the minimum domain outside its normal molecular context may be problematic because earlier work had suggested that the N- and C-terminal portions of Pho81, that is regions outside the minimum domain, could provide competing inhibitory and stimulatory functions for Pho81 (Ogawa et al., 1995).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Ogawa et al., 1995.

claims.claim: Pho81 lacking the N-terminal 200 amino acids (Pho81ΔSPX) localized to the nucleus.
claims.source: This Pho81ΔSPX is likely to be folded because a yEGFP-tagged version of Pho81ΔSPX localized to the nucleus (Figure 6C and D), which requires Pho81 to interact with nuclear import factors and with Pho85-Pho80 (Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6C and D.

claims.claim: Nuclear localization of Pho81 requires interaction with nuclear import factors and with Pho85-Pho80.
claims.source: This Pho81ΔSPX is likely to be folded because a yEGFP-tagged version of Pho81ΔSPX localized to the nucleus (Figure 6C and D), which requires Pho81 to interact with nuclear import factors and with Pho85-Pho80 (Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Huang et al., 2001.

claims.claim: pho81ΔSPX cells partially maintained Pho4yEGFP in the cytosol upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: Whereas wildtype cells efficiently relocated Pho4yEGFP to the nucleus upon Pi starvation, pho81ΔSPX cells partially maintained Pho4yEGFP in the cytosol.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6A and B.

claims.claim: The SPX domain is not essential for nuclear targeting of Pho81.
claims.source: Thus, while the SPX domain is not essential for nuclear targeting of Pho81, it is required for efficient nuclear relocation of Pho4 and the induction of the PHO pathway under Pi starvation.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observation that Pho81ΔSPX still localizes to the nucleus.

claims.claim: The SPX domain is required for efficient nuclear relocation of Pho4 and induction of the PHO pathway under Pi starvation.
claims.source: Thus, while the SPX domain is not essential for nuclear targeting of Pho81, it is required for efficient nuclear relocation of Pho4 and the induction of the PHO pathway under Pi starvation.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6A and B.

claims.claim: Several lysines on α-helix 4 of SPX domains form part of an inositol pyrophosphate-binding patch.
claims.source: Several lysines located on α-helix 4 of SPX domains form part of an inositol pyrophosphate-binding patch (Ried et al., 2021; Pipercevic et al., 2023).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Ried et al., 2021 and Pipercevic et al., 2023.

claims.claim: Substituting lysines in the SPX domain binding patch by alanine severely reduces affinity for inositol pyrophosphates.
claims.source: Substituting them by alanine severely reduces the affinity of the domains for inositol pyrophosphates and can thus mimic the inositol pyrophosphate-free state.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about SPX domain mutagenesis.

claims.claim: Pho81K154A-yEGFP concentrates in the nuclei of cells.
claims.source: Pho81K154A-yEGFP should be correctly folded because it concentrates in the nuclei of the cells (Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6C.

claims.claim: pho81K154A cells constitutively activated the PHO pathway with Pho4yEGFP accumulating in the nucleus under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: pho81K154A cells constitutively activated the PHO pathway because Pho4yEGFP accumulated in their nucleus already under Pi-replete conditions (Figure 6A and B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6A and B.

claims.claim: Constitutive PHO pathway activation in pho81K154A cells was also observed in a pho81K154A vip1Δ double mutant.
claims.source: This constitutive activation was also observed in a pho81K154A vip1Δ double mutant, confirming that 1-IP7 synthesis by Vip1 is not necessary for PHO pathway induction.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6A and B.

claims.claim: 1-IP7 synthesis by Vip1 is not necessary for PHO pathway induction.
claims.source: This constitutive activation was also observed in a pho81K154A vip1Δ double mutant, confirming that 1-IP7 synthesis by Vip1 is not necessary for PHO pathway induction.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the pho81K154A vip1Δ double mutant phenotype.

claims.claim: PHO81 expression is under the control of the PHO pathway.
claims.source: Induction of the PHO pathway through SPX substitutions is further illustrated by PHO81 expression, which itself is under the control of the PHO pathway (Figure 6E and F).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge about PHO pathway regulation.

claims.claim: pho81K154A cells showed increased levels of Pho81 under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: Western blots of protein extracts from cells grown under Pi-replete conditions showed increased levels of Pho81 in pho81K154A cells, like those observed in strains that constitutively activate the PHO pathway due to the absence of inositol pyrophosphates, such as kcs1Δ and vip1Δ/kcs1Δ.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6E and F.

claims.claim: The PHO pathway is regulated through binding of inositol pyrophosphates to the SPX domain of Pho81.
claims.source: In sum, these results suggest that the PHO pathway is regulated through binding of inositol pyrophosphates to the SPX domain of Pho81.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the SPX domain mutagenesis results.

claims.claim: Random mutagenesis approaches generated pho81c alleles (G4D, G147R, 158-SGSG-159, E79K) that constitutively activate the PHO pathway.
claims.source: These random mutagenesis approaches generated multiple pho81c alleles, which constitutively activate the PHO pathway and carry the substitutions G4D, G147R, 158-SGSG-159, or E79K.
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Ogawa et al., 1995 and Creasy et al., 1993.

claims.claim: All pho81c alleles affect the SPX domain at residues in the immediate vicinity of the putative inositol pyrophosphate-binding site.
claims.source: All these alleles affect the SPX domain at residues in the immediate vicinity of the putative inositol pyrophosphate-binding site (Figure 7).
claims.evidence: This is supported by structural analysis shown in Figure 7.

claims.claim: Three pho81c alleles (G4D, G147R, 158-SGSG-159) replace small glycine residues by bulky residues or insert additional amino acids at sites that should sterically interfere with inositol pyrophosphate binding.
claims.source: Three of the alleles (G4D, G147R, 158-SGSG-159) replace small glycine residues by bulky residues or insert additional amino acids, respectively, at sites where they should sterically interfere with binding of inositol pyrophosphates.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on structural considerations.

claims.claim: pho81c alleles are expected to mimic the inositol pyrophosphate-free state and constitutively activate the PHO pathway.
claims.source: We hence expect them to mimic the inositol pyrophosphate-free state and constitutively activate the PHO pathway for this reason.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the structural effects of the mutations.

claims.claim: Alphafold multimer v3 prediction shows the minimum domain binding a long unstructured loop of Pho81 in a groove of Pho80.
claims.source: The prediction shows the groove binding a long unstructured loop of Pho81, which corresponds to the minimum domain.
claims.evidence: This is based on structural prediction shown in Figure 8.

claims.claim: Substitutions in the minimum domain (residues 690-701) constitutively repress the PHO pathway when introduced into full-length Pho81.
claims.source: Substitutions in the minimum domain, and specifically of the residues binding the Pho80 groove in the prediction (residues 690–701), constitutively repress the PHO pathway when introduced into full-length Pho81, and they destabilize the interaction of Pho81 with Pho85-Pho80 (Ogawa et al., 1995; Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Ogawa et al., 1995 and Huang et al., 2001.

claims.claim: pho80R121K and pho80E154V alleles ablate the critical salt bridge in the Pho80 groove.
claims.source: The same effects are also shown by the pho80R121K and pho80E154V alleles, which ablate the critical salt bridge in the Pho80 groove (Huang et al., 2001; Huang et al., 2007).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Huang et al., 2001 and Huang et al., 2007.

claims.claim: The minimum domain may serve as an anchor for Pho80 on Pho81 rather than acting directly on Pho85 kinase.
claims.source: It invites a re-interpretation of the role of the minimum domain and suggests that this domain may serve as an anchor for Pho80 on Pho81 rather than acting directly on the Pho85 kinase.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the structural prediction and mutational data.

claims.claim: Recruitment of Pho81 to the nucleus and its interaction with Pho85-Pho80 in wildtype cells is independent of the Pi regime.
claims.source: The recruitment of Pho81 to the nucleus and its interaction with Pho85-Pho80 in wildtype cells is independent of the Pi regime, suggesting that it is dominated by a constitutive interaction (Figure 6C; Huang et al., 2001).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 6C and a citation to Huang et al., 2001.

claims.claim: In pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells, recruitment of Pho81 to the nucleus becomes Pi-sensitive and is stimulated by Pi starvation.
claims.source: This constitutive recruitment vanishes when the minimum domain-binding site is compromised in pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells. Then, recruitment of Pho81 to the nucleus and to Pho85-Pho80 becomes Pi-sensitive and is stimulated by Pi starvation (Figure 9).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: Under Pi-replete conditions, pho80R121K or pho80E154V cells showed Pho81yEGFP in the cytosol.
claims.source: Under Pi-replete conditions, pho80R121K or pho80E154V cells showed Pho81yEGFP in the cytosol, but they accumulated the protein in the nucleus upon Pi starvation (Figure 9).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells accumulated Pho81yEGFP in the nucleus upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: Under Pi-replete conditions, pho80R121K or pho80E154V cells showed Pho81yEGFP in the cytosol, but they accumulated the protein in the nucleus upon Pi starvation (Figure 9).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: Rescue by Pi starvation was more pronounced in pho80R121K than in pho80E154V.
claims.source: This rescue by starvation was more pronounced in pho80R121K than in pho80E154V.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: Pho81K154A-yEGFP accumulated in the nucleus of pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells already under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: Pho81K154A-yEGFP, with a substitution in its putative inositol pyrophosphate binding site designed to mimic the low-Pi state, accumulated in the nucleus of pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells already under Pi-replete conditions, that is, it behaved constitutively as under Pi starvation.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: vip1Δ mutants accumulated Pho81yEGFP in the nucleus of pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: vip1Δ mutants behaved like the wildtype, accumulating Pho81yEGFP in the nucleus of pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells upon Pi starvation, whereas kcs1Δ cells showed nuclear Pho81yEGFP already under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: kcs1Δ cells showed nuclear Pho81yEGFP in pho80R121K and pho80E154V backgrounds already under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: vip1Δ mutants behaved like the wildtype, accumulating Pho81yEGFP in the nucleus of pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells upon Pi starvation, whereas kcs1Δ cells showed nuclear Pho81yEGFP already under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: Interfering with inositol pyrophosphate signaling partially compensated for destabilization of the minimum domain binding site in Pho80.
claims.source: Thus, interfering with inositol pyrophosphate signaling, be it through Pi starvation, ablation of inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, or substitution of the putative inositol pyrophosphate binding site of Pho81, partially compensated for the destabilization of the minimum domain binding site in Pho80.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the rescue experiments shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: Pho81ΔSPX-yEGFP did not show starvation-induced nuclear accumulation in pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells.
claims.source: First, Pho81ΔSPX-yEGFP, which lacks this SPX domain, did not show starvation-induced nuclear accumulation in pho80R121K and pho80E154V cells (Figure 9).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 9.

claims.claim: A yEGFP fusion of only the SPX domain of Pho81 (Pho81SPXyEGFP) localized mainly to the cytosol of PHO80 wildtype cells under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: Second, a yEGFP fusion of only the SPX domain of Pho81 (Pho81SPXyEGFP), which lacks the rest of the protein and thereby excludes a constitutive interaction through the minimum domain, localized mainly to the cytosol of PHO80 wildtype cells under Pi-replete conditions, but it concentrated in the nucleus upon Pi starvation (Figure 10).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 10.

claims.claim: Pho81SPXyEGFP concentrated in the nucleus upon Pi starvation in PHO80 wildtype cells.
claims.source: Second, a yEGFP fusion of only the SPX domain of Pho81 (Pho81SPXyEGFP), which lacks the rest of the protein and thereby excludes a constitutive interaction through the minimum domain, localized mainly to the cytosol of PHO80 wildtype cells under Pi-replete conditions, but it concentrated in the nucleus upon Pi starvation (Figure 10).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 10.

claims.claim: Nuclear concentration of Pho81SPXyEGFP was not observed in pho80Δ cells.
claims.source: This concentration was not observed in pho80Δ cells, which lack nuclear Pho85-Pho80.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 10.

claims.claim: pho80R121K or pho80E154V cells retained the capacity to accumulate Pho81SPXyEGFP in their nuclei upon Pi starvation.
claims.source: By contrast, pho80R121K or pho80E154V cells, which only target the minimum domain-Pho80 interaction but leave Pho85-Pho80 kinase active and in the nucleus (Huang et al., 2007), retained the capacity to accumulate Pho81SPXyEGFP in their nuclei upon Pi starvation.
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 10.

claims.claim: The SPX domain contributes to the interaction of Pho81 and Pho85-Pho80.
claims.source: These results suggest that the SPX domain contributes to the interaction of Pho81 and Pho85-Pho80.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the Pho81SPXyEGFP localization experiments.

claims.claim: The SPX-Pho85-Pho80 interaction is independent of the minimum domain but controlled by Pi through inositol pyrophosphates.
claims.source: Our observations are consistent with a model in which this SPX-Pho85-Pho80 interaction is independent of the minimum domain but controlled by Pi through inositol pyrophosphates, which can destabilize it and relieve the inhibition of Pho85-Pho80.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the combined results from Figures 9 and 10.

claims.claim: Pi scarcity is signaled by a decrease in inositol pyrophosphates rather than by an increase.
claims.source: We propose that Pi scarcity is signaled by a decrease in inositol pyrophosphates rather than by an increase; a critical function is ascribed to the loss of 1,5-IP8 instead of 1-IP7; and we postulate that the N-terminal SPX domain of Pho81 rather than the central minimum domain is the primary receptor mediating inositol pyrophosphate control over the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is a summary of the main conclusions from the study.

claims.claim: A critical function is ascribed to the loss of 1,5-IP8 instead of 1-IP7 in PHO pathway regulation.
claims.source: We propose that Pi scarcity is signaled by a decrease in inositol pyrophosphates rather than by an increase; a critical function is ascribed to the loss of 1,5-IP8 instead of 1-IP7; and we postulate that the N-terminal SPX domain of Pho81 rather than the central minimum domain is the primary receptor mediating inositol pyrophosphate control over the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is a summary of the main conclusions from the study.

claims.claim: The N-terminal SPX domain of Pho81 is the primary receptor mediating inositol pyrophosphate control over the PHO pathway.
claims.source: We propose that Pi scarcity is signaled by a decrease in inositol pyrophosphates rather than by an increase; a critical function is ascribed to the loss of 1,5-IP8 instead of 1-IP7; and we postulate that the N-terminal SPX domain of Pho81 rather than the central minimum domain is the primary receptor mediating inositol pyrophosphate control over the PHO pathway.
claims.evidence: This is a summary of the main conclusions from the study.

claims.claim: In vitro activity assays showed a clear order of potency of inositol pyrophosphates in stimulating VTC, with 1,5-IP8 showing an apparent EC50 30-fold below that of 5-IP7 and 50-fold below that of 1-IP7.
claims.source: Our in vitro activity assays had shown a clear order of potency of inositol pyrophosphates in stimulating VTC, with 1,5-IP8 showing an apparent EC50 30-fold below that of 5-IP7 and 50-fold below that of 1-IP7 (Gerasimaite et al., 2017).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Gerasimaite et al., 2017.

claims.claim: A vip1Δ mutant shows quite normal polyP accumulation in vivo.
claims.source: In this work, we nevertheless dismissed 1,5-IP8 as a physiological stimulator of the VTC SPX domains, based on the argument that a vip1Δ mutant, which lacks the enzyme for 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 synthesis, shows quite normal polyP accumulation in vivo.
claims.evidence: This references previous observations from the authors' earlier work.

claims.claim: A kcs1Δ mutant lacks polyP.
claims.source: We proposed 5-IP7 for this role because a kcs1Δ mutant, which lacks the IP6K making this compound, also lacks polyP.
claims.evidence: This references previous observations.

claims.claim: The presence of polyP in a vip1Δ mutant can be explained by the 20-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7 in this mutant.
claims.source: The presence of polyP in a vip1Δ mutant can well be explained by the 20-fold overaccumulation of 5-IP7 in this mutant, which can compensate for the lower EC50 and permit stimulation of VTC through 5-IP7.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the current study's findings about 5-IP7 overaccumulation in vip1Δ.

claims.claim: In wildtype cells, 1,5-IP8 should be the relevant activator of VTC for polyP synthesis under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.source: In wildtype cells, however, where 5-IP7 is only twice as abundant as 1,5-IP8 (Figure 2), 1,5-IP8 should be the relevant activator of VTC for polyP synthesis under Pi-replete conditions.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the relative concentrations of inositol pyrophosphates and their EC50 values.

claims.claim: Ablation of the Vip1 homolog Asp1 in S. pombe impairs polyP synthesis.
claims.source: Then, the situation is also compatible with results from S. pombe, where ablation of the Vip1 homolog Asp1 impairs polyP synthesis (Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2021; Schwer et al., 2022).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2021 and Schwer et al., 2022.

claims.claim: Deletion of the Vip1 homolog Asp1 in S. pombe leads to a strong increase in IP7.
claims.source: Like in baker's yeast, deletion of the Vip1 homolog Asp1 leads to a strong increase in IP7 (Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018.

claims.claim: Pi stimulates net production of IP8 by inhibiting the phosphatase domain of Asp1 in S. pombe.
claims.source: Characterization of the purified enzyme also showed that Pi stimulates net production of IP8 by inhibiting the phosphatase domain of Asp1 (Benjamin et al., 2022).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Benjamin et al., 2022.

claims.claim: IP8 rapidly decreased upon Pi starvation in S. pombe.
claims.source: In line with this, we observed that IP8 rapidly decreased upon Pi starvation also in S. pombe (Figure 3).
claims.evidence: This is supported by data shown in Figure 3.

claims.claim: Genetic ablation of Asp1 in S. pombe does not interfere with the induction of the phosphate-regulated gene PHO1 by Pi starvation.
claims.source: As for Vip1 in baker's yeast, genetic ablation of Asp1 does not interfere with the induction of the phosphate-regulated gene PHO1 by Pi starvation, suggesting that 1-IP7 and 1,5-IP8 are not essential for this transcriptional response (Estill et al., 2015).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Estill et al., 2015.

claims.claim: In Pi-replete media, ablation of Asp1 in S. pombe hyper-represses PHO1.
claims.source: In Pi-replete media, however, ablation of Asp1 hyper-represses PHO1, and putative overproduction of 1-IP7 and/or 1,5-IP8 by selective inactivation of only the Asp1 phosphatase domain induces this gene (Estill et al., 2015; Garg et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Estill et al., 2015 and Garg et al., 2020.

claims.claim: Putative overproduction of 1-IP7 and/or 1,5-IP8 by selective inactivation of the Asp1 phosphatase domain induces PHO1 in S. pombe.
claims.source: In Pi-replete media, however, ablation of Asp1 hyper-represses PHO1, and putative overproduction of 1-IP7 and/or 1,5-IP8 by selective inactivation of only the Asp1 phosphatase domain induces this gene (Estill et al., 2015; Garg et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to Estill et al., 2015 and Garg et al., 2020.

claims.claim: Ablation of Asp1 in S. pombe increases the IP7 pool four- to fivefold.
claims.source: It remains to be seen whether these discrepancies originate from a similar disequlibration of IP7 species as in S. cerevisiae (ablation of Asp1 increases the IP7 pool four- to fivefold Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018), or whether they are due to other processes such as lncRNA-mediated interference, which plays an important role in Pi homeostasis in S. pombe (Sanchez et al., 2018; Schwer et al., 2015; Schwer et al., 2014).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Pascual-Ortiz et al., 2018.

claims.claim: The PHO pathway in C. neoformans shares many protein components with that of S. cerevisiae.
claims.source: The PHO pathway in C. neoformans, a pathogenic yeast, shares many protein components with that of S. cerevisiae and might hence be expected to function in a similar manner (Toh-e et al., 2015).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Toh-e et al., 2015.

claims.claim: A recent study on C. neoformans proposed 5-IP7 as the critical inducer of the PHO pathway.
claims.source: Yet a recent study on this organism proposed 5-IP7 as the critical inducer of the PHO pathway (Desmarini et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to Desmarini et al., 2020.

claims.claim: kcs1Δ mutants in C. neoformans cannot induce the PHO pathway.
claims.source: This model relies on the observation that kcs1Δ mutants, which lack 5-IP7, cannot induce the PHO pathway in this yeast.
claims.evidence: This references findings from Desmarini et al., 2020.

claims.claim: Pho81 was lacking completely from kcs1Δ mutants in C. neoformans.

claims.claim: Loss of 1,5-IP8 may generally signal phosphate scarcity in eukaryotic cells.
